lines.say: At nine fourteen, a painting just... vanished.

lines.text: The gallery? Locked. And only three people had a key.
The guard swore: I watched those cameras all night!
The cleaner said: I left at nine. Ask the bus driver!
And yep, the driver remembered her. Bus 9, at 9:02.
lines.say: And yep, the driver remembered her. Bus nine, at nine-oh-two.

lines.text: The owner? I was home. Besides, it's insured.
Two million dollars. Now that's a reason to lie.
But his doorman saw him walk in at eight.
So Inspector Hale pulled the camera footage.
And look: rain, running down the gallery window.
Problem is, it hadn't rained in Ashford all week.
That footage was old. Someone looped it!
And only one person had access to those cameras.
Case closed. So... did you catch the rain?
lines.say: Case closed. So... did you catch the rain?
